verdict.rationale: No evidence explicitly addresses whether customer data is used to train AI models. The closest support is indirect: a dedicated instance or VPC deployment with "full data isolation" and "privacy, control, and security," plus a community report of self-hosting the official Docker image, would keep data inside the customer's own environment. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or training opt-out control, coverage of the standard SaaS tier (not just dedicated/VPC), and independent corroboration of training-data practices.
